C1246.title: Huabei and Baitiao Cash-Out Scam Disguised as Loan Qualification Improvement
C1246.summary: Yangzhou Intermediate People Court disclosed a fraud case. The criminal group claimed to help victims apply for online loans, fabricated poor credit qualifications, induced victims to cash out Alipay Huabei or JD Baitiao credit limits, and charged high fees. Ultimately, 13 defendants were sentenced for fraud to prison terms ranging from one year and eight months to twelve years. If the June 2024 disclosure time is retained, the original page publication date should be supplemented.
